question: Are any menu items spiking or dropping unusually?

tool_calls.query:
SELECT 
  DATE(t.txn_ts) as txn_date,
  p.name,
  p.category,
  SUM(i.qty) as total_qty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) as num_txns,
  ROUND(SUM(i.qty) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id), 2) as avg_qty_per_txn
FROM tenant_transaction_items i
JOIN tenant_transactions t ON i.txn_id = t.txn_id
JOIN tenant_products p ON i.sku = p.sku
WHERE t.merchant_id = 'TBL'
GROUP BY DATE(t.txn_ts), p.sku, p.name, p.category
ORDER BY txn_date DESC, total_qty DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT 
  p.name,
  p.category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= '2026-05-23' THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) as recent_qty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-05-09' AND '2026-05-22' THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) as baseline_qty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= '2026-05-23' THEN t.txn_id ELSE NULL END) as recent_txns,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-05-09' AND '2026-05-22' THEN t.txn_id ELSE NULL END) as baseline_txns,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) >= '2026-05-23' THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) - 
                 SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-05-09' AND '2026-05-22' THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END)) /
         NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-05-09' AND '2026-05-22' THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) as pct_change
FROM tenant_transaction_items i
JOIN tenant_transactions t ON i.txn_id = t.txn_id
JOIN tenant_products p ON i.sku = p.sku
WHERE t.merchant_id = 'TBL'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, p.category
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-05-09' AND '2026-05-22' THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY ABS(pct_change) DESC
LIMIT 50

response_dict.prose:
---

## **Headline**

**Widespread menu-item decline across nearly all categories in the most recent week (May 23–29) — down 40–51% versus the baseline (May 9–22).** This is not a single-SKU spike but a broad operational drop affecting breakfast items, burritos, tacos, drinks, combos, and sides. No evidence of a promotional driver or seasonal event.

## Details

- **Cinnabon Delights (2 ct)** dropped **51.2%** (159 units recent vs. 326 baseline; 138 txns → 277 txns)
- **Lemonade Md** fell **46.8%** (355 units → 667 units)
- **$5 Cravings Box** declined **46.7%** (288 units → 540 units)
- **Black Bean Burrito** down **46.6%** (181 units → 339 units)
- **Power Menu Bowl**, **Breakfast Combo**, **Chalupa-style Taco**, **Big Box**, and **Chicken Chalupa** all fell in the **43–46% range**

The pattern is systemic: **every category shows decline**, with virtually no exceptions. Transaction counts also dropped proportionally, suggesting reduced store traffic overall rather than a menu-mix shift.

## Business Interpretation

The synchronized decline across all product categories and reduction in transaction volume points to **lower overall store traffic** in the May 23–29 window, likely driven by external factors such as a local holiday (Memorial Day fell on May 27, 2026), weekend-skew effects, or weather. This is an **operational traffic anomaly**, not a menu or promotion issue. Individual item performance is declining because the denominator (daily transactions per store) is lower.

## Caveats
caveats: Assumed most recent 7 days (May 23–29) vs. the prior 14-day baseline (May 9–22).
No same-segment peers available for traffic comparison; analysis limited to own-merchant time-series.
Memorial Day (May 27) falls within the recent window and may explain some or all of the decline.
